note: observed = returned by the live gateway to an unpaid probe (cost $0). assumed = not yet seen live; the mock uses this text until the paid spike replaces it.

invalid_json_body.message: bad request: invalid JSON: expected ident at line 1 column 2

missing_max_tokens.message: bad request: x402 requests must include max_tokens or max_completion_tokens

stream_not_supported.message: bad request: x402 tokenless streaming is not enabled; use an MPP session

invalid_payment_json.message: bad request: invalid payment header JSON: expected ident at line 1 column 2

missing_tx_signature.message: bad request: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE is missing the Solana transaction signature

unsupported_network.message: bad request: only Solana and Base x402 payments are supported

tx_not_found.message: bad request: Solana transaction not found or not yet confirmed

quote_mismatch.message: bad request: x402 quote does not match this request

balance_missing_proof.message: bad request: balance spend requires payload.proof (signed quote id)

balance_missing_payer.message: bad request: balance spend requires payer_wallet

balance_proof_malformed.message: bad request: proof is not a 64-byte ed25519 signature

balance_proof_invalid.message: bad request: proof signature does not verify for payer_wallet

balance_insufficient.message: bad request: x402 wallet balance is below the quote cap ({cap} microunits); pay on-chain instead

signature_replayed.message: bad request: transaction signature already used for another quote

underpaid.message: bad request: payment is below the quoted amount

balance_envelope.provenance: observed: the gateway gets past its format and signature checks and reaches the balance check

json.proof: <ed25519 signature over utf8 'usepod-x402-spend:<quote_id>', base58 or base64>

balance_envelope.gotcha: The error text says payload.proof, but a nested payload.proof is NOT read. The proof must be the top-level field 'proof'.
